title: Leona holds the line
prompt: Stage 2-5, level 5. You just made Leona 2-star. Varus and Karma are your damage. Kobuko is your only frontliner. Place Leona.
explanation:
Leona is a Defender: armour, magic resist and a stun. She exists to be hit. Put her in the front row next to Kobuko so the two of them form a wall in the middle and the enemy melee units have to go through both. Varus and Karma keep shooting from four hexes back.

A tank alone on a corner gets walked around; two tanks side by side in the centre get walked into. Column 3 or 4 is best; column 1 still touches Kobuko and is acceptable.
principle: Frontliners stand together, in the middle, in front of the damage.
commonMistake: Putting the new tank on the far side of the board to protect the carry there, which splits the frontline in two and lets enemies through the gap.
